title: Spatial Methods Workbench
description:
Spatial Methods Workbench is a citation-aware R Shiny environment with 12 guided workflows for spatial autocorrelation, conditional networks, spatially adjusted 2D and 3D networks, prediction, clustering, image-regression screening, mediation, and statistical shape analysis.

This corrected complete source distribution contains the installable Workbench package, Shiny application, five executable vignettes, four compact simulated datasets, complete documentation, 51 automated checks, and locally bundled package sources for the exact public ISPAT, GP-GHS, and ISPAT-3D engines. install-complete.R installs those local engine copies without cloning their repositories.

A curated public-source bundle also preserves license-safe regression, clustering, neural, SV-NN, STCAR, and SBLF source connected to the Workbench adaptations and related-method provenance. Exact engine calls, built-in adaptations, and related screening workflows remain explicitly distinguished. Large curriculum translations, media, demonstration datasets, Git history, and platform-specific compiled objects are omitted because they do not execute a Workbench analysis.

Installation

Download and extract the release, then run Rscript install-complete.R, Rscript verify-installation.R, and Rscript tests/testthat.R. The README contains platform prerequisites, advanced and related-engine options, verification, local launch, Docker, privacy, and troubleshooting guidance. Missing CRAN dependencies may be downloaded; the three direct method repositories do not need to be downloaded separately.

Required attribution

Users must cite this software release and the method-specific publications or software applicable to the workflow used. The complete bibliography is included in REFERENCES.md and in result bundles. Public sources are identified by repository, commit, license, retained scope, and role in vendor/manifest.json.

Only public, release-scoped material is included in this record.
